character.name: Goliath
character.visual_identity: towering quad-horned stone golem beast with glowing amber magma veins pulsing through cracked granite hide, moss-covered rocky shoulders, glowing molten eyes, ancient runic carved markings
character.signature_gear: chipped obsidian battle club, chest bound in massive iron chain link
character.physical_condition: Right stone horn partially severed in ancient battle, immense brute mass
character.mental_state: primordial intelligence, protective of subterranean wildlife, wary of surface human incursions

eras.name: Era 1: The Awakening
eras.subtitle: The Tremor
eras.description: Deep beneath the earth, tectonic fracking shatters Goliath's thousand-year slumber. He must navigate collapsing magma caverns and surface drilling rigs.
eras.visual_palette: subterranean magma orange, obsidian rock, glowing sulfur steam, colossal cave caverns

eras.name: Era 2: The Surface Breach
eras.subtitle: The Lost Sun
eras.description: Goliath surfaces into a ruined human city overrun by mutant megafauna, claiming territory against rival apex titan predators.
eras.visual_palette: ruined overgrown skyscrapers, tangled roots, stormy twilight sky, titan scale perspective

world_state.weather: Dense toxic ash fall, waning daylight
world_state.threat: Subterranean acoustic crawlers active in shadows
